title: On a Characterization of the Ruled Cubic Surface in PG(4,Q)
content: Some five years ago, S.G. Barwick and Wen-Ai Jackson provided a nice combinatorial characterization of the ruled cubic surface in PG(4,q). They proved that, in PG(4,q), qph odd, q9, a point-set K of size q2+2q+1 and class [q+1,2q+1,3q+1]3, such that every plane that contains four points of K contains at least q+1 points of K, is the ruled cubic surface. They also showed that the incidence plane condition is sharp, but nothing they wrote about the size assumption. In this note, by proving that, in PG(r,q), r5, q9, a set of class [q+1,2q+1,3q+1]3 is of class [q2+2q+1,3q22q+1,3q2q+1]4, we show that the size assumption cannot be removed.
